svg.text: P6 — EVENT BACKBONE, MODEL GATEWAY, OBSERVABILITY & 1M-JOB SCALE ARCHITECTURE
Provide reliable event transport, scalable worker execution, model routing and full observability while keeping AI off authoritative hard-rule/state decisions.
Numbering, naming and event linkage corrected.
Items marked FIXED changed in this edition.
P6 transports at-least-once events to idempotent consumers.
Worker pools scale independently by domain load.
Model Gateway selects provider/model based on capability, risk,
latency and cost; outputs advice/structured reasoning refs.
Deterministic domain validates model outputs before authority.
Observability tracks SLOs and cross-layer traces.
Scale physically only when measured load justifies separation.
AI required on critical path? minimize/avoid where deterministic path
Model provider failure? fallback/defer noncritical reasoning.
AI outage → deterministic core continues where possible.
Stage 1: modular monolith + relational DB + background workers.
Stage 3: selected service extraction from measured hotspots.
Stage 4: multi-region partitioning/domain stores for sustained high
Target is 1M+ jobs/month logical architecture, not a promise of 1M
Learning may propose, never auto-publish compliance rules.
Million-job logical architecture now; million-job physical
P6-G1 · Model provider outage during execution
P6-G2 · 1M/mo matching uses derived index + authoritative recheck
P6-G3 · Lost callback replay remains idempotent
Board regenerated from the corrected canonical set. Text is real SVG text — readable by script, not only by eye.
Every consumed event on this board has exactly one producer, or is declared external. Open rulings are listed in the canonical file, not decided here.
